name: paper-orchestra-studio
description: PaperOrchestra Studio: local AI scientific paper workbench for Claude Code.

plugins.name: paper-orchestra-studio
plugins.description: End-to-end AI scientific paper workbench: multi-agent paper pipeline, 19 venue LaTeX templates, XeLaTeX/SyncTeX workbench, 8-source literature graph, Research Studio SOPs, figure studio, Nature and Lean 4 audits, reviewer response, venue preflight, claim-evidence audit, talk and poster kits, HTML/Word/PDF export and SSH/GPU management.

plugins.name: paper-orchestra-pane
plugins.description: Sidebar pane for Claude Code (/po-pane): Studio status, projects, runs, jobs, literature library and environment checks, driven by the paper-orchestra-studio plugin's tools.
